sentences.text:
Through: Mr. Salim Malik, Adv.
 versus  STATE ..
 Through: Mr. Aashneet Singh, A  with Insp. Laln Keshr  Nagar  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JASMEET SINGH  ORDER % 23.03.2023 Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
This is an application seeking bail in FIR No. 297/2018 registered at PS Jyoti Nagar u/s 302/201 IPC and Sections 376/34 IPC, added in the chargesheet.

It is stated by Mr. Malik, learned counsel for the applicant that even though the legging and chappal was recovered at the instance of the applicant, there is no FSL or document to show that the legging and chappal belonged to the deceased victim.
The applicant is in custody since 26.08.2018 and the evidence would take a considerable time and the applicant is still an undertrial prisoner.
Mr. Singh, learned APP accepts notice, seeks and is granted 2 weeks to file a status report.
Let Nominal Roll be requisitioned from jail authorities, indicating any other involvement of the applicant, if any.
